Message:
rt2x00: Enable multiBSS in rt2800

MAC_BSSID_DW1_BSS_ID_MASK must be set to the mask 3, to
enable 8 BSSID's. The MAC_BSSID_DW1_BSS_BCN_NUM is initialized
to 7 to enable the 8 beacons.
